recommendation_note: Stands, with corrections. The anchors and counts reproduce against live LSR, USGS, FEMA, GHCN and IEM pages and against the cached NCEI, SV and B1 files. Gate 1 holds: Benchland ETN 42 cover, June 2022 flood, Glendive 4.00 in, the Livingston and Great Falls gusts, the Jan 2024 cold, the April 2022 Billings snow and the 2025-08-19 heat gap with the NCEI gap. Before gating: item 1 stands, and the note must say that the Glendive 14.4 mm value depends on the rule (6.4 mm under exact half-even). Item 2 must say the six core GHCN elements end 2025-02-06, not every element. Item 3 is confirmed (USC00244558, current to 2026-10-15). Item 4 must replace 'up to 9 F' with 8.9 F (BIL), 16.2 F (GTF) and 10.0 F (MSO) on highs and 20.1 F on lows at MSO, and the TMIN mean difference is 1.0 to 1.3 F at GTF and MSO. Item 5 is resolved: 2,240 is the all-office count and the Montana box gives 2,122 to 2,126. Also fix the Larslan (6 NNE) coordinates and the Webster time example (+8 h).
